<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$tokens = new IndieAuth\Token\User( '_indieauth_token_', 1 );
$clients = array(
	array( 'Quill', 'https://quill.p3k.io/', 'create update media' ),
	array( 'Indigenous', 'https://indigenous.realize.be/', 'create update delete media read follow channels' ),
	array( 'Micropublish', 'https://micropublish.net/', 'create update' ),
);
foreach ( $clients as $i => $client ) {
	$tokens->set(
		array(
			'token_type'  => 'Bearer',
			'scope'       => $client[2],
			'me'          => home_url( '/' ),
			'issued_by'   => rest_url( 'indieauth/1.0/token' ),
			'user'        => 1,
			'client_id'   => $client[1],
			'client_name' => $client[0],
			'issued_at'   => time() - ( $i + 1 ) * WEEK_IN_SECONDS,
		),
		( $i + 2 ) * MONTH_IN_SECONDS
	);
}
flush_rewrite_rules();
